pain_point: Marketing waits several days for engineering to make pricing and landing-page changes.
subject: Acme Analytics: ship one backlog item without joining the engineering queue
message:
Hi there,

The use case that stood out for Acme Analytics is: Marketing waits several days for engineering to make pricing and landing-page changes.

Sparkles lets non-engineering teammates request changes against an existing GitHub codebase while the work still comes back as a reviewable PR, so engineering keeps its normal controls.

Would it be useful to test one real backlog item and see the PR Sparkles produces?

- Okechukwu
